newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Tax Office sees risk of tax collapse.
newsitem.headline: Australian Tax Office sees risk of tax collapse.

text.p: The Australian Tax Office (ATO) said on Sunday aggressive tax planning by many high income earners could lead to a collapse in revenue collections.

ATO Commissioner Michael Carmody said the office had already started audits of those high earners paying little tax and may also recommend changes in tax laws to prevent such large scale tax avoidance.
"We're looking into the issue because we see a signficant risk there," Carmody told Channel Nine's Business Sunday television programme.

"The magnitude of the deals, the level of aggressive tax planning going on...given the magnitude of the deals we could face a collapse in collections and that's not something that we're prepared to do," he said.

"We're already taking some audit action, we will take action in the courts and it may be that we'll be advising government of where there are areas in the law that are being exploited for this purpose."
